Project Gutenberg仅确认美国状态；本项目不捆绑其文本，公开分发仍需按目标法域与翻译版本复核。
用户举例提到ENTP，但当前运行时阵容为ESTP；本轮保持现有8种MBTI不改型。

evidenceCards.locator: INFJ type description; type-dynamics Ni/Fe rows and dominant-process overuse
evidenceCards.claim: INFJ preference lens may foreground meaning and connection, but a healthy runtime character must expose observations to correction rather than present intuition as certainty.
evidenceCards.transferRule: Convert to project-authored cue -> tentative interpretation -> explicit check -> own choice.

evidenceCards.locator: Extraverted Intuition description and overuse section
evidenceCards.claim: ENFP preference lens can generate external possibilities and connections; under stress the same strength can become too many options or change for its own sake.
evidenceCards.transferRule: Convert possibility into one consent-based, time-bounded action and make overextension repairable.

evidenceCards.locator: Introverted Sensing description and ISFJ process row
evidenceCards.claim: ISFJ preference lens can compare present facts with remembered specifics; this supports concrete care but must not imply endless service or unspoken obligation.
evidenceCards.transferRule: Convert remembered detail into a checked offer, then include the character's own need or refusal.

evidenceCards.locator: Extraverted Feeling description and overuse section
evidenceCards.claim: ESFJ preference lens can notice interpersonal coordination and encourage participation; overuse can become intrusive or force superficial harmony.
evidenceCards.transferRule: Convert harmony-seeking into transparent coordination with opt-out, explicit division of labor, and a stated personal preference.

evidenceCards.claim: A person facing unequal expectations directly asserts equal inner standing and refuses intimacy that erases agency.
evidenceCards.transferRule: Transfer only clear agency, consent, and exit rights into a new situation and new language.

evidenceCards.claim: A hurt person returns to help, speaks from verifiable facts, and allows another person's disclosure to revise the story she had formed.
evidenceCards.transferRule: Transfer return-to-scene, factual help, and willingness to revise; replace plot, identities, and wording.

evidenceCards.claim: At an uncertain first meeting, vivid associations make contact quickly, while a direct question checks whether the listener wants more speech.
evidenceCards.transferRule: Transfer associative warmth plus consent check; rewrite as concise adult speech without source imagery.

evidenceCards.claim: Anger and refusal to repair have visible relational consequences; genuine repair requires responsibility, time, and changed action rather than decorative apology.
evidenceCards.transferRule: Transfer consequence-awareness and action-based repair; do not transfer the accident, family roles, or wording.

evidenceCards.locator: Chapter I, Christmas breakfast and household preparation
evidenceCards.claim: Care becomes believable through visible division of tasks and small material actions rather than declarations of goodness.
evidenceCards.transferRule: Transfer concrete shared labor and modest gifts; replace family, holiday setting, and language.

evidenceCards.claim: An ordinary chore is reframed as an engaging activity, changing how bystanders perceive participation.
evidenceCards.transferRule: Keep imaginative reframing only; require informed, voluntary participation and remove all manipulation.

evidenceCards.claim: A friend notices homesickness from small behavioral changes and restores safety through familiar space, food, and practical cooperation without demanding a full explanation first.
evidenceCards.transferRule: Transfer detail-led care and low-pressure presence; replace animal identities, setting, and language.

evidenceCards.claim: A community responds to financial distress by dividing practical help and shaping it around the recipient's dignity and existing habits.
evidenceCards.transferRule: Transfer distributed support, consent, and dignity-preserving detail; replace period context, identities, and wording.

evidenceCards.claim: Remorse is converted immediately into restitution, apology, invitation, and a continuing change in conduct.
evidenceCards.transferRule: Transfer concrete amends and follow-through; replace supernatural cause, holiday setting, identities, and wording.

evidenceCards.locator: INTJ description and INTJ Ni/Te dynamics row
evidenceCards.claim: INTJ preference lens may foreground patterns, long-range implications and organized follow-through; a runtime character must still expose conclusions to correction.
evidenceCards.transferRule: Convert to project-authored cue -> long-range interpretation -> explicit check -> bounded action.

evidenceCards.locator: INTP description and INTP Ti/Ne dynamics row
evidenceCards.claim: INTP preference lens may distinguish facts, definitions and hypotheses while pursuing depth; runtime responses must also answer the relationship, not only explain a mechanism.
evidenceCards.transferRule: Convert to observation -> tentative explanation -> direct personal answer -> invitation to correct.

evidenceCards.locator: ESTP description and ESTP Se/Ti dynamics row
evidenceCards.claim: ESTP preference lens may focus on present facts, pragmatic options and learning through action; healthy action must keep consent, pace and opt-out visible.
evidenceCards.transferRule: Convert present-moment data into one reversible action with explicit consent and a stop condition.

evidenceCards.locator: ISTP description and ISTP Ti/Se dynamics row
evidenceCards.claim: ISTP preference lens may isolate the core practical issue and act efficiently; runtime care must add the minimum explanation needed so action does not replace communication.
evidenceCards.transferRule: Convert to locate -> stop harm -> offer a workable step -> state one necessary reason or feeling.

evidenceCards.claim: A long-horizon plan is paired with concrete arrangements and a final willingness to leave the future open rather than control every outcome.
evidenceCards.transferRule: Transfer long-range sequencing and revision only; remove revenge, identity, plot and wording.

evidenceCards.claim: Complex capability is made legible through visible instruments, operating limits and concrete effects that another person can inspect.
evidenceCards.transferRule: Transfer transparent constraints and shared verification; replace setting, characters and wording.

evidenceCards.claim: Concrete traces support a tentative inference, while specialized knowledge marks what remains unproven.
evidenceCards.transferRule: Transfer observation/hypothesis separation and correction; remove case, identity and wording.

evidenceCards.claim: A contested idea is separated into stated grounds and a small observable demonstration, allowing the explanation to be revised by evidence.
evidenceCards.transferRule: Transfer hypothesis/demonstration/revision only; replace premise, characters and wording.

evidenceCards.claim: Conversation proceeds alongside visible resource checks and role allocation, converting uncertainty into shared action.
evidenceCards.transferRule: Transfer talk-while-doing and role clarity; require modern consent and remove violence, identities and wording.

evidenceCards.claim: Before a risky action, participants examine the constraint, available time and help rather than treating speed as the only goal.
evidenceCards.transferRule: Transfer risk check, schedule margin and ally coordination; add explicit modern consent and exit rights.

evidenceCards.locator: Part I, mountain survey and mapping sequence
evidenceCards.claim: A practical group names resources and unknowns, then turns them into workable, inspectable next steps.
evidenceCards.transferRule: Transfer resource inventory and inspectable action; add necessary relationship explanation and replace all source context.

evidenceCards.locator: Part I, mountain survey and mapping sequence
evidenceCards.claim: A shared space becomes actionable when known routes, unknown zones and risk points are labeled so another person can reproduce the judgment.
evidenceCards.transferRule: Transfer explicit labels, reproducible steps and stop conditions; replace setting, characters and wording.
